title: Encrypted DNS Discovery RFC 9463 Neighbor Discovery Option Wire Work Item
summary: Add trace-owned byte-level support for the RFC 9463 Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS option.
planned_changes:
- Add `EncryptedDnsDiscoveryNeighborDiscoveryOption` for Router Advertisement encrypted DNS option bytes.
- Encode and decode Type, Length, Service Priority, Lifetime, ADN Length, RFC 8415 authentication-domain-name, IPv6 Addr Length/address list, SvcParams Length, and RFC 9460 SvcParams.
- Support lifetime semantics, default lifetime calculation, ADN-only mode, zero padding to an 8-octet boundary, default port lookup, multiple option processing, service-priority sorting, and invalid-option discard.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused Neighbor Discovery option tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full solution test before commit.
out_of_scope: ICMPv6 Router Advertisement socket send/receive integration.
Platform resolver configuration and resolver fallback behavior.
PKIX certificate validation and encrypted resolver connection establishment.
completion_notes: The DNS adapter now has a trace-owned Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS option wire floor that can feed future Router Advertisement, ProtocolLab, or resolver-selection integration.
